issues.description: The UML in the problem statement shows the lecture attributes as private (prefixed with '-') while the template Lecture.java pre-declares two attributes as public (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents). The solution uses private fields for all attributes. This visibility mismatch between the problem statement, template, and solution can confuse students about the intended access level (private with getters/setters) and may lead them to implement fields with incorrect visibility or skip implementing getters/setters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Lecture.java consistent with the UML and the solution by declaring all attributes as private (remove or change the public modifiers on lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents) and leave TODO placeholders for students to add the remaining attributes. This clarifies that students should implement private fields with getters/setters as shown in the UML and solution.
